project_type: FastAPI + SQLAlchemy 2.0 backend with React 18 + TypeScript + Vite frontend, PostgreSQL 16 (pgvector) + Redis 7 + MinIO S3, Celery workers
build_system: pip + requirements.txt (backend), npm + Vite (frontend), Docker Compose (infrastructure)
test_framework: pytest for backend (12 test files in backend/tests/), no frontend tests currently exist
build_command: Backend: pip install -r requirements.txt && python main.py | Frontend: npm install && npm run dev | Docker: docker compose up --build
verification_instructions:
1. Start infrastructure: docker compose up -d postgres redis minio
2. Start backend: cd backend && python main.py (port 8000)
3. Start frontend: cd frontend && npm run dev (port 5173)
4. Run tests: cd backend && pytest tests/ -v
5. Verify health: curl http://localhost:8000/api/v1/health
6. Verify discovery: Test /api/v1/discovery/jobs endpoint with valid API keys
snapshot_or_generated_files: None - all database schema managed via Alembic migrations in backend/alembic/versions/ (4 migration files exist)
environment_constraints: PostgreSQL and Redis must be running (Docker containers crm_leads_postgres and crm_leads_redis). Backend requires .env file with API keys (Apify, Gemini, etc.). Never commit .env files. Frontend expects backend at http://localhost:8000/api/v1 in development.
contribution_requirements:
1. All database changes require Alembic migration
2. Maintain FastAPI async patterns where applicable
3. Use Pydantic v2 for schemas
4. Frontend uses Tailwind CSS for styling
5. Follow existing code organization (API → Services → Models → Providers)
6. Add type hints to all Python functions
7. Add TypeScript types to all React components
key_patterns:
1. Provider pattern: Base class in providers/<type>/base.py, implementations extend it
2. AI Router fallback: Gemini → OpenRouter → Heuristic (never throw unhandled exceptions)
3. Database sessions: Use get_db() dependency injection, never create SessionLocal directly in routes
4. API routes: FastAPI router with prefix/tags, located in api/v1/<feature>.py
5. Services: Business logic in services/<feature>_service.py, routes are thin controllers
6. Models: SQLAlchemy 2.0 declarative_base, UUID primary keys via GUID type
7. Frontend API calls: Use api.ts axios instance, handle errors in interceptors
8. React patterns: Functional components with hooks, lazy loading for routes
directory_structure: backend/app/ contains ai/ (agents), api/v1/ (routes), core/ (config, db), extractors/ (contact parsing), models/ (SQLAlchemy), providers/ (integrations), schemas/ (Pydantic), services/ (business logic), workers/ (Celery). frontend/src/ contains components/, hooks/, pages/ (30+ feature pages), services/ (API client), types/. Infrastructure: docker-compose.yml defines postgres, redis, minio, backend, celery_worker, frontend services.
